# Auth cookie preservation on email change redirect (2026-01-31 20:02Z)

_**User**_

In `@app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts` around lines 1 - 61, The route  
currently calls redirect() from next/navigation which throws and prevents the  
auth cookies set via createServerClient/verifyOtp from reaching the client;  
update the GET handler to return a NextResponse.redirect(...) (or use the  
existing redirectWithCookies helper) and copy all cookies from  
supabaseResponse.cookies into that response before returning so the session  
cookie is preserved for all paths (invalid type, missing token_hash, verifyOtp  
error, and successful redirect to "/protected"); locate the logic around GET,  
supabaseResponse, createServerClient and the verifyOtp call and replace each  
redirect(...) invocation with a returned NextResponse.redirect that includes the  
cookies from supabaseResponse.  

---

_**Agent (model composer-1, mode Agent)**_


Reviewing the current implementation to replace `redirect()` with `NextResponse.redirect()` and preserve cookies.

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims().         "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid type\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid token hash\")}&#96;);\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!(await hasEmailIdentity(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"No code provided\")}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n  const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         },
        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { InfoIcon } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { FetchDataSteps } from \"@/components/tutorial/fetch-data-steps\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\n\nasync function UserDetails() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  if (error || !data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return JSON.stringify(data.claims, null, 2);\n}\n\nexport default function ProtectedPage() {\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://localhost:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\",\n]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable.         "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!(await hasEmailIdentity(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1.         "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/error\";\n    url.searchParams.set(\"error\", \"Invalid type\");\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/error\";\n    url.searchParams.set(\"error\", \"Invalid token hash\");\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/error\";\n    url.searchParams.set(\"error\", error.message);\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"No code provided\")}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n  const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt;         "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\nexport default async function Page() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to protected page if already logged in\n  if (data?.claims) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;LoginForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)\norioledb_version = \"\"\n# Configures S3 bucket URL, eg. &lt;bucket_name&gt;.s3-&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com\ns3_host = \"env(S3_HOST)\"\n# Configures S3 bucket region, eg. us-east-1\ns3_region = \"env(S3_REGION)\"\n# Configures AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 bucket\ns3_access_key = \"env(S3_ACCESS_KEY)\"\n# Configures AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for S3 bucket\ns3_secret_key = \"env(S3_SECRET_KEY)\"",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 70
          }
        },
        "contents": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches:\n      - preview\n      - production\n    paths:\n      - 'supabase/**'\n      - '.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml'\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      environment:\n        description: 'Environment to deploy to'\n        required: true\n        type: choice\n        options:\n          - preview\n          - production\n\njobs:\n  deploy_preview:\n    environment: preview\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/preview' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push || (supabase db reset --linked --yes &amp;&amp; supabase db push --include-all)\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'production')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },

            "text": "on:",

          },

            "text": "  push:",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "range": {

            "line": 25

        },
        "contents": "---\ndescription: Coding rules for Supabase Edge Functions\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Writing Supabase Edge Functions\n\nYou're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:\n\n## Guidelines\n\n1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)\n2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.\n3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.\n4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.\n5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.\n6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.\n7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.\n8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:\n   - SUPABASE_URL\n   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_DB_URL\n9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

## Summary

Updated `/app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts` to fix cookie preservation:

1. Removed the `redirect` import from `next/navigation` (line 3).
2. Replaced all `redirect()` calls with `NextResponse.redirect()`:
   - Invalid type (lines 18-22)
   - Missing token_hash (lines 24-28)
   - verifyOtp error (lines 62-73)
   - Successful redirect (lines 76-85)
3. Preserved cookies by copying Set-Cookie headers from `supabaseResponse` to each redirect response using `headers.getSetCookie()`, which preserves options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, path, etc.).

The route now returns `NextResponse.redirect()` responses with cookies copied, so auth cookies set by `createServerClient`/`verifyOtp` reach the client in all cases (invalid type, missing token_hash, verifyOtp error, and successful redirect).

No linting errors. Ready to use.

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!(await hasEmailIdentity(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (!(await hasLinkedProfile(supabase))) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1.         "contents": "/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */\nfunction redirectWithCookies(\n  url: URL,\n  supabaseResponse: NextResponse,\n): NextResponse {\n  const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  const setCookieHeaders = supabaseResponse.headers.getSetCookie();\n  setCookieHeaders.forEach((cookieHeader) =&gt; {\n    redirectResponse.headers.append(\"Set-Cookie\", cookieHeader);\n  });\n  return redirectResponse;\n}\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-6\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold\"&gt;Pending Approval&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              Your email address has been verified, but you need an admin to approve your account before you can access protected areas.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/50\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n              Please contact an administrator to approve your email address. Once approved, you will be able to access all protected areas of the application.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.\n11. File write operations are ONLY permitted on &#96;/tmp&#96; directory. You can use either Deno or Node File APIs.\n12. Use &#96;EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(promise)&#96; static method to run long-running tasks in the background without blocking response to a request. Do NOT assume it is available in the request / execution context.\n\n## Example Templates\n\n### Simple Hello World Function\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\ninterface reqPayload {\n  name: string\n}\n\nconsole.info('server started')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const { name }: reqPayload = await req.json()\n  const data = {\n    message: &#96;Hello ${name} from foo!&#96;,\n  }\n\n  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {\n    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Connection: 'keep-alive' },\n  })\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example Function using Node built-in API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { createServer } from 'node:http'\nimport process from 'node:process'\n\nconst generateRandomString = (length) =&gt; {\n  const buffer = randomBytes(length)\n  return buffer.toString('hex')\n}\n\nconst randomString = generateRandomString(10)\nconsole.log(randomString)\n\nconst server = createServer((req, res) =&gt; {\n  const message = &#96;Hello&#96;\n  res.end(message)\n})\n\nserver.listen(9999)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Using npm packages in Functions\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport express from 'npm:express@4.18.2'\n\nconst app = express()\n\napp.get(/(.*)/, (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.send('Welcome to Supabase')\n})\n\napp.listen(8000)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Generate embeddings using built-in @Supabase.ai API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nconst model = new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const params = new URL(req.url).searchParams",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: Coding rules for Supabase Edge Functions\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Writing Supabase Edge Functions\n\nYou're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:\n\n## Guidelines\n\n1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)\n2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.\n3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.\n4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.\n5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.\n6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.\n7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.\n8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:\n   - SUPABASE_URL\n   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_DB_URL\n9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "# Writing Supabase Edge Functions",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "You're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## Guidelines",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_URL",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_DB_URL",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",
            "lineNumber": 25
          }

## Summary

1. **Added helper functions to `lib/auth-helpers.ts`**:
   - `createErrorUrl()` - Creates error URLs with error messages
   - `createSuccessUrl()` - Creates success redirect URLs
   - `redirectWithCookies()` - Creates redirect responses with cookies preserved

2. **Updated `app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts`**:
   - Removed local helper functions
   - Now imports and uses the shared helpers from `auth-helpers.ts`

3. **Updated `app/auth/callback/route.ts`**:
   - Switched from `createClient()` to `createServerClient` pattern to preserve cookies
   - Replaced all `redirect()` calls with `NextResponse.redirect()` and `redirectWithCookies()`
   - Now uses the shared helpers from `auth-helpers.ts`
   - Cookies are preserved in all redirect scenarios

Both routes now:
- Use shared helper functions (DRY)
- Preserve auth cookies when redirecting
- Follow the same pattern for consistency

No linting errors. Ready to use.
